execution.training_feasibility_conclusion: Both feedback seeds fail frozen source TRAIN-panel21-group feasibility. This is not solely a held-out generalization failure. Near-price feedback multiplier reached cap10 (s42 epochs59..60, s43 epochs30..60); all feedback updates were globally clipped. This diagnoses optimization pressure, not proof that a larger cap or budget would succeed.
limits: No real weights or neural forward executed locally. Six current and two source checkpoint bytes/Adam moments/RNG payloads are omitted from report; their SHA/signature/restore receipts were cross-bound, not reloaded locally.
Source TRAIN Q0 and 21 baselines were not independently regenerated from model weights; immutable calibration schedule, raw/row/statistics/source bindings and source replay were checked.
Final TRAIN risks are verified as frozen-panel arithmetic and identity from reports, not independently recomputed predictions: calibration-panel predictions are not exported.

Online epoch aggregates describe changing weights. Epoch objective cannot be reconstructed exactly from only epoch-level risk aggregates when per-effective-batch supports differ; objective formula is bound to released code and effective-batch preflight receipt.

Research full128 prediction shards/raw caches are intentionally omitted; omission SHA consistency is not a local prediction recomputation. Metric agent handles exported scores and fixed eight-position predictions.
Successful execution/engineering checks do not establish scientific acceptance, generalization, generic embedding utility or forecasting.
No production metrics imported; independently implemented NumPy arithmetic reused for unchanged metric definitions.
No local model loading, neural forward, gradients or fitting. Real weights and full128 predictions are omitted; their receipt binding does not replace neural replay.
All128 errors are independently aggregated but only fixed8 predictions can be independently rescored.
Raw close price windows checked against original local CSV hashes; body/activity scoring uses supplied target arrays and masks, not fresh independent feature regeneration.
Repeated research cohorts are not independent V13 validation; protections are correlated and not independent discoveries.
Failure of this bounded feedback recipe cannot distinguish architecture capacity from optimization or establish architecture optimality.
